description: NEW AWS CDK v2 (Python) app under cdk/ that auto-provisions the whole lab on ONE EC2 whose user-data boots the EXISTING docker-compose stack. Pure addition: does NOT rebuild app/, service-b/, config/, or docker-compose.yml. The CDK stack provisions the default VPC (from_lookup) + public subnet, a least-privilege Security Group (22/3000/optional-8000 only from a -c allowedCidr CIDR; 9090/3100/4317/4318/16686 stay CLOSED), an IAM role obs-lab-ec2-role with AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore (NO X-Ray), a t3.small Amazon Linux 2023 instance with a 20GiB gp3 root, an aws_s3_assets.Asset bundling the lab code, and cloud-init user-data that installs Docker + the compose plugin, downloads+unpacks the asset to /opt/obs-lab, writes .env with OTEL_ENABLED=true, and runs `docker compose up -d`. CfnOutputs expose the public IP, Grafana URL, and the Jaeger SSM/SSH tunnel command. Everything tagged Project=obs-lab. VALIDATE WITH `cdk synth` ONLY — do NOT run `cdk deploy` and do NOT create any AWS resources. Independent of FEAT-005 (docs) except that FEAT-005 documents it. Tooling confirmed on host: aws-cdk CLI 2.1139.0, node v22.19.0, python3 3.12.2.
steps: Create the cdk/ Python CDK v2 skeleton: cdk/app.py (#!/usr/bin/env python3; `import aws_cdk as cdk`; instantiate `ObsLabStack(app, 'ObsLabStack', env=cdk.Environment(account=os.environ.get('CDK_DEFAULT_ACCOUNT','550428926318'), region=os.environ.get('CDK_DEFAULT_REGION','us-east-1')))`; `cdk.Tags.of(app).add('Project','obs-lab')`; `app.synth()`). cdk/cdk.json (`{"app": "python app.py", "context": {"keyName": "ec2-docker-api-key", "vpcId": "vpc-059b7fcb3ae44690e"}}`). cdk/requirements.txt pinning an EXACT published aws-cdk-lib 2.x (e.g. aws-cdk-lib==2.160.0 — if that exact version does not pip-install cleanly on Python 3.12, pick the latest installable 2.x and pin it exactly) plus `constructs>=10.0.0,<11.0.0`. cdk/README.md: a SHORT note on synth/deploy (NOT a third tutorial). cdk/obs_lab/__init__.py (empty).

Implement cdk/obs_lab/obs_lab_stack.py `ObsLabStack(Stack)`: (a) read `allowedCidr = self.node.try_get_context('allowedCidr')`; if missing/empty raise ValueError telling the student to pass `-c allowedCidr=$(curl -s https://checkip.amazonaws.com)/32`. (b) VPC via `ec2.Vpc.from_lookup(self, 'DefaultVpc', is_default=True)`. (c) SG `obs-lab-sg` (allow_all_outbound=True) with ingress tcp 22, tcp 3000, and tcp 8000 (gate 8000 behind context `openApiPort` default True) ALL from `ec2.Peer.ipv4(allowedCidr)`; NEVER open 9090/3100/4317/4318/16686. (d) IAM `obs-lab-ec2-role` assumed_by ec2.amazonaws.com with managed policy AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore and NO X-Ray policy. (e) `ec2.Instance` type t3.small, `machine_image=ec2.MachineImage.latest_amazon_linux2023()`, the SG + role, a public subnet (`vpc_subnets=ec2.SubnetSelection(subnet_type=ec2.SubnetType.PUBLIC)`), `block_devices=[ec2.BlockDevice(device_name='/dev/xvda', volume=ec2.BlockDeviceVolume.ebs(20, volume_type=ec2.EbsDeviceVolumeType.GP3))]`, `associate_public_ip_address=True`, `key_name` from context (omit/None when the context value is empty). (f) tag the instance Name=obs-lab-ec2.

Add the code asset + user-data in cdk/obs_lab/obs_lab_stack.py: `asset = aws_s3_assets.Asset(self, 'LabCode', path=os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), '..', '..'), exclude=['.git','.venv','__pycache__','*.pyc','.pytest_cache','.env','.agents','cdk/cdk.out','node_modules'])`; `asset.grant_read(instance.role)`. Build `user_data = ec2.UserData.for_linux()` and `user_data.add_commands(...)` for the script in the FEAT findings/plan outline: `set -euxo pipefail`; `dnf update -y`; `dnf install -y docker unzip`; `systemctl enable --now docker`; `usermod -aG docker ec2-user`; install docker compose v2 plugin to /usr/local/lib/docker/cli-plugins/docker-compose (chmod +x); `mkdir -p /opt/obs-lab`; `aws s3 cp s3://<asset.s3_bucket_name>/<asset.s3_object_key> /tmp/lab.zip --region <stack region>`; `unzip -o /tmp/lab.zip -d /opt/obs-lab`; write /opt/obs-lab/.env with GF_SECURITY_ADMIN_PASSWORD=changeme, OTEL_ENABLED=true, OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT=http://otel-collector:4317, LOAD_TEST_RATE=3, LOAD_TEST_DURATION=60; `cd /opt/obs-lab && docker compose build && docker compose up -d`. Attach the user_data to the instance. Interpolate asset.s3_bucket_name / asset.s3_object_key via f-strings or `Fn` tokens so the synthesized template carries the real bucket/key references.

Add CfnOutputs in the stack: PublicIp (instance.instance_public_ip), PublicDnsName (instance.instance_public_dns_name), GrafanaUrl (f'http://{instance.instance_public_ip}:3000' built with a token-safe `Fn` or CfnOutput value), JaegerTunnelCommand (the exact `aws ssm start-session --target <instance-id> --document-name AWS-StartPortForwardingSession --parameters '{"portNumber":["16686"],"localPortNumber":["16686"]}' --profile stay` string AND an SSH `-L 16686:localhost:16686` alternative), and SsmSessionCommand (`aws ssm start-session --target <instance-id> --profile stay`). Use instance.instance_id in the command outputs.

Add .env.example a one-line comment (do NOT change existing values) stating that on EC2 the .env is generated by user-data with OTEL_ENABLED=true. Leave docker-compose.yml, app/, service-b/, config/ UNCHANGED.

Install the CDK app deps in an isolated venv and run `cdk synth` to validate. If `ec2.Vpc.from_lookup` cannot resolve credentials in this environment, synth with `--no-lookups` and record in findings that the real VPC lookup happens at the student's `cdk deploy`. Extract the synthesized user-data and run `bash -n` on it (write the script body to a temp file and `bash -n` that file) to confirm no shell syntax errors; delete the temp file afterward.
acceptance_criteria: cdk/ exists as a self-contained CDK v2 Python app (app.py, cdk.json, requirements.txt, obs_lab/obs_lab_stack.py, obs_lab/__init__.py) and `cdk synth` (with -c allowedCidr=<ip>/32, using --profile stay or --no-lookups) produces a CloudFormation template without error.

The synthesized template contains exactly one AWS::EC2::Instance (t3.small), an AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup opening ONLY 22/3000/8000 from the allowedCidr (no 9090/3100/4317/4318/16686 ingress), an AWS::IAM::Role referencing AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore, a 20GiB gp3 root volume, and NO X-Ray resource/permission anywhere.

The synthesized user-data installs docker + the compose plugin, downloads the CDK code asset, writes .env with OTEL_ENABLED=true, and runs `docker compose up -d`; the extracted user-data passes `bash -n`.
CfnOutputs expose the public IP, the Grafana URL (http://<ip>:3000), and the Jaeger SSM/SSH tunnel command.

No `cdk deploy` was run and no AWS resources were created (only local cdk.out/). docker-compose.yml and the app/service-b/config code are unchanged; `docker compose config -q` still passes and `pytest tests/` still shows 12 passed.
verification: cd cdk && python -m venv .venv && . .venv/bin/activate && pip install -r requirements.txt
cd cdk && . .venv/bin/activate && cdk synth -c allowedCidr=203.0.113.9/32 --profile stay || cdk synth --no-lookups -c allowedCidr=203.0.113.9/32
grep -q 'docker compose up -d' cdk/cdk.out/ObsLabStack.template.json && grep -q 'OTEL_ENABLED=true' cdk/cdk.out/ObsLabStack.template.json
. .venv/bin/activate 2>/dev/null || (python -m venv .venv && . .venv/bin/activate && pip install -r app/requirements.txt pytest); pytest tests/ -q
findings:
DONE. Created a self-contained AWS CDK v2 (Python) app under cdk/: app.py (App entrypoint, env from CDK_DEFAULT_ACCOUNT/REGION with fallback account=550428926318 region=us-east-1, Tags Project=obs-lab app-wide), cdk.json (app='python app.py', context keyName=ec2-docker-api-key, vpcId=vpc-059b7fcb3ae44690e), requirements.txt, README.md (short, not a tutorial), obs_lab/__init__.py (empty), and obs_lab/obs_lab_stack.py (the ObsLabStack). Also added a one-line comment to .env.example (values unchanged) and added cdk/cdk.out/ and cdk/.venv/ to .gitignore. docker-compose.yml, app/, service-b/, config/ UNCHANGED.

PINNED VERSION: aws-cdk-lib==2.160.0 (pip-installed cleanly on Python 3.12.2; synthesizes with aws-cdk CLI 2.1139.0). constructs>=10.0.0,<11.0.0.

STACK CONTENTS: VPC via ec2.Vpc.from_lookup(is_default=True); public subnet selection; SG obs-lab-sg (allow_all_outbound=True) ingress tcp 22, 3000, and 8000 (8000 gated behind context openApiPort default True) all from ec2.Peer.ipv4(allowedCidr); ports 9090/3100/4317/4318/16686 NEVER opened. IAM role obs-lab-ec2-role assumed_by ec2.amazonaws.com with ONLY AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore (NO X-Ray anywhere) + asset.grant_read for least-privilege S3 read. ec2.Instance t3.small, MachineImage.latest_amazon_linux2023(), 20GiB gp3 root at /dev/xvda, associate_public_ip_address=True, key_name from context (None when empty => SSM-only), Name=obs-lab-ec2 tag. s3_assets.Asset bundles REPO_ROOT (os.path.join(dirname,'..','..')) excluding .git/.venv/__pycache__/*.pyc/.pytest_cache/.env/.agents/cdk/cdk.out/cdk/.venv/node_modules; CDK zips the directory asset by default so unzip is correct. allowedCidr required-context guard raises ValueError with the checkip hint.

HOW SYNTH WAS RUN: `cdk synth -c allowedCidr=203.0.113.9/32 --profile stay` SUCCEEDED using the real `stay` credentials (the from_lookup VPC resolution worked online; --no-lookups fallback was NOT needed). Template written to cdk/cdk.out/ObsLabStack.template.json. NO cdk deploy was run and NO AWS resources were created (only the local cdk.out/).

VERIFICATION ALL PASSED: template has exactly 1 AWS::EC2::Instance (t3.small), 1 AWS::IAM::Role, AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore present, VolumeType gp3 / VolumeSize 20, ingress FromPorts only {22,3000,8000}, X-Ray match count = 0, `docker compose up -d` present, OTEL_ENABLED=true present. Extracted user-data passed `bash -n`. `docker compose config -q` OK. `pytest tests/` => 12 passed.

REAL ASSET-DOWNLOAD COMMAND SHAPE in synthesized user-data (bucket/key are the CDK bootstrap-bucket references): `aws s3 cp s3://cdk-hnb659fds-assets-550428926318-us-east-1/<assetHash>.zip /tmp/lab.zip --region us-east-1` then `unzip -o /tmp/lab.zip -d /opt/obs-lab`. compose plugin pinned to v2.29.7.

FOR FEAT-005 (docs rewrite):
- CfnOutput names (exact): PublicIp, PublicDnsName, GrafanaUrl, SsmSessionCommand, JaegerTunnelCommand.
- GrafanaUrl value = http://<PublicIp>:3000 ; Grafana login admin / password from the generated .env (changeme).
- Command lines (student runs these; we did NOT):
    cdk bootstrap aws://550428926318/us-east-1 --profile stay
    cdk synth  -c allowedCidr=$(curl -s https://checkip.amazonaws.com)/32 --profile stay
    cdk deploy -c allowedCidr=$(curl -s https://checkip.amazonaws.com)/32 --profile stay
    cdk destroy -c allowedCidr=$(curl -s https://checkip.amazonaws.com)/32 --profile stay
  Run them from the cdk/ directory with the venv active (python -m venv .venv; . .venv/bin/activate; pip install -r requirements.txt).
- -c allowedCidr usage: REQUIRED context; synth/deploy/destroy all error with a ValueError + checkip hint if omitted. Recommend `-c allowedCidr=$(curl -s https://checkip.amazonaws.com)/32`.
- Optional context: `-c keyName=""` for SSM-only (no SSH), `-c openApiPort=false` to not expose port 8000.
- Jaeger SSM port-forward command (exact):
    aws ssm start-session --target <instance-id> --document-name AWS-StartPortForwardingSession --parameters '{"portNumber":["16686"],"localPortNumber":["16686"]}' --profile stay
  SSH alternative: ssh -i ec2-docker-api-key.pem -L 16686:localhost:16686 ec2-user@<public-ip>
- SsmSessionCommand: aws ssm start-session --target <instance-id> --profile stay
- Internal-only ports reached via tunnel: Prometheus 9090, Loki 3100, OTLP 4317/4318, Jaeger UI 16686.
- Student verify after deploy: SSM/SSH in, `docker ps`, check /var/log/cloud-init-output.log for user-data completion.
